far this is the worst doctors I’ve ever been registered with, Dr Wright is dishonest and Dr Khaine has no compassion or empathy for her patients, she also needs training on human rights, bedside manner and DNR’s when the patient is asking for it. I’ve seen Dr Khaine 3 times and so far she’s done nothing to help me, she’s told me she’s doing lots of things and then I get to the next appointment to find she was mouthing off and never had any intention of making the referrals or booking the blood tests she had told me she was booking. She is also incapable of prescribing properly she added the wrong meds to my repeat list not once but twice…the same thing as well!!!
As far as I’m concerned this surgery is a waste of time and will likely kill people.
This surgery also refuses to keep accurate up to date medical records, I have proof of this and am reporting them to GDPR and the NHS, and the health board.
As for Dr Wright, she literally lied in her response to my complaint but of course it’s her word over mine, I asked her for a DNR something you can have even if your not sick, the doctors only refusal option is mental competency and having you committed, she refused, when I complained she lied about the whole appointment, despite the fact it’s my word against hers I will be making formal complaints to the GMC about her dishonesty.

Update: I’ve now been removed from their surgery list by the practice manager Lena Sperber for posting this review, I was given an ultimatum of remove the review or get kicked off, apparently expecting at least an apology for their misgivings is blackmail! She’s cited patient doctor relationship breakdown which isn’t true because I’ve seen and spoken to my registered doctor, Dr Anderson (absolutely lovely lady who will always try to help you) since then and she knew nothing about it and is going out of her way to help me move elsewhere.
